model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%) for various models, including Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT, and ROME. The x-axis, labeled "Co-occurrence Number", has a logarithmic scale, ranging from 0 to $10^3$, with tick labels at $10^0$, $10^1$, $10^2$, and $10^3$. The y-axis, labeled "ACC (%)", has a linear scale, ranging from 40 to 65, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot displays six lines, each representing a different model: Base (black, solid line, circle marker), FT (blue, solid line, triangle marker), IKE (red, solid line, triangle marker), MEND (brown, solid line, diamond marker), MEMIT (purple, solid line, circle marker), and ROME (green, solid line, square marker). The Base line starts at approximately 38 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increases to around 45 at $10^3$, showing a steady trend. The FT line begins at about 39 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and rises to approximately 49 at $10^3$, also displaying a steady trend. The IKE line commences at roughly 40 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and reaches around 50 at $10^3$, exhibiting a steady increase. The MEND line starts at approximately 41 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and ascends to about 56 at $10^3$, showing a steady trend. The MEMIT line begins at around 44 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increases to approximately 57 at $10^3$, displaying a steady trend. The ROME line starts at about 51 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and rises to around 66 at $10^3$, showing a steady increase.
